strings.zh: 这里是以精灵竞技的现在以及{NEWLINE}精灵和人类的{CLEAR}信任之心为主题的,{SCROLL}被称为「信赖」的房间。
strings.en: This is the room called “Trust.”{SCROLL}Its theme is the Pokéathlon of today{NEWLINE}and the trust between Pokémon and{CLEAR}people.
strings.notes: US 0141/0 | RV039: omission: the present of the Pokéathlon dropped

strings.zh: 这之后是要用同一个精灵{NEWLINE}取得５枚奖章！{CLEAR}只有优秀的口袋竞技员{CLEAR}才被允许进入。
strings.en: Only the Pokéathletes who have{NEWLINE}come first in five courses with{CLEAR}one Pokémon are allowed here.

strings.zh: 这前面是「可能性」的房间,{NEWLINE}请通过吧。
strings.en: Ahead is the “Potential” room.{NEWLINE}Please go on through.
strings.notes: US 0141/2 | RV039: meaning: the room is ahead, not this one

strings.zh: 依靠各种精灵取得奖章,{SCROLL}若不信赖你的精灵{NEWLINE}是很无法达成的。
strings.en: To win Medals with different kinds of{NEWLINE}Pokémon, it is essential to believe in{CLEAR}your Pokémon.

strings.zh: 我也想要努力,想在这里{NEWLINE}展示自己的鞋子！
strings.en: I want to work hard too, so I can have{NEWLINE}my own shoes displayed here!
strings.notes: US 0141/4 | RV039: omission: work hard dropped

strings.zh: 这个圆顶里,{NEWLINE}有着许多会场呢！
strings.en: There are so many venues inside this{NEWLINE}Dome!
strings.notes: US 0141/5 | RV039: meaning: venues, not other Domes

strings.zh: 参加精灵竞技的次数达到{NEWLINE}５０次的人,{SCROLL}挑战永无止境,{NEWLINE}在此为其不屈不挠的意志鼓掌。
strings.en: Those who have participated in the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon 50 times are commemorated{CLEAR}here for their never-yielding spirits.

strings.zh: 装饰有写着{NEWLINE}自己签名的运动衫！
冲刺次数达到５０００次的人,{SCROLL}在此为其打破传说的壮举{NEWLINE}鼓掌。
strings.en: Those who have dashed 5,000 times{NEWLINE}are commemorated here for their{CLEAR}achievement in breaking the{CLEAR}legendary record.

strings.zh: 交换次数达到２００次的人,{SCROLL}和朋友一起协力合作,{NEWLINE}在此为其深刻的羁绊鼓掌。
strings.en: Those who have switched 200 times,{NEWLINE}working together with their friends, are{CLEAR}commemorated here for their deep{CLEAR}bonds.
strings.notes: US 0141/11 | RV039: meaning: teamwork with friends

strings.en: It’s a cool flag!{NEWLINE}And it’s yours!

strings.zh: 口袋竞技奖章⋯⋯{SCROLL}这是精灵和口袋竞技员{NEWLINE}共同努力的证明。{SCROLL}特别是收集到５个奖章的精灵,{SCROLL}为了表彰那只精灵和{NEWLINE}口袋竞技员的信赖,{CLEAR}授予其「最佳拍档」称号。
strings.en: Pokéathlon Medals...{SCROLL}They are proof of the hard work of{NEWLINE}Pokémon and Pokéathletes together.{SCROLL}In particular, Pokémon that have{NEWLINE}collected five Medals{SCROLL}are given the title “Best Partner” to{NEWLINE}honor the trust between that Pokémon{CLEAR}and its Pokéathlete.
strings.notes: US 0141/13 | RV039: name: 最佳拍档 = Best Partner title, not Medalist Pokémon
US 0141/14; modernised from US 0141#14 | RV039: meaning: wants to sleep, not already asleep (D-1672)
